entities.summary: Oscar Anders Klefbom is a Swedish former professional ice hockey defenceman. He last played for the Edmonton Oilers of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected 19th overall in the 2011 NHL Entry Draft by the Oilers. Klefbom was born in Karlstad, Sweden, and grew up in Hammarö.
